definitions.gloss: to volunteer; to apply; to enlist
definitions.explanation: To offer oneself for a task, position, or service of one's own will. Often used for military enlistment or applying for a challenging role.

examples.japanese: {自|みずか}ら{志願|しがん}した。
examples.english: He/she volunteered of their own accord.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{海外|かいがい}{派遣|はけん}に{志願|しがん}した。
{危険|きけん}な{任務|にんむ}だったが、{多|おお}くの{隊員|たいいん}が{志願|しがん}して{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: It was a dangerous mission, but many members volunteered to participate.

notes:
{志願|しがん}する emphasizes acting of one's own will, especially for difficult or important tasks.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) / intransitive depending on use
- Pattern: [task/role]に{志願|しがん}する or [task/role]を{志願|しがん}する

WORD FORMATION:
{志|し} (will, aspiration) + {願|がん} (wish, desire)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {志願|しがん}{兵|へい}: volunteer soldier
- {志願|しがん}{者|しゃ}: volunteer, applicant
- {自|みずか}ら{志願|しがん}する: to volunteer of one's own accord

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {応募|おうぼ}する: to apply (general, for jobs/contests)
- {志願|しがん}する: to volunteer (emphasizes personal will, often for challenging roles)
- ボランティアする: to volunteer (for community/charity work)
